card.name: Adding one drug to another
card.fires_on: Words about adding or combining a drug, such as adding, addition, added, or co-administration, just before the added drug is named. Also linking words like by or with before a drug alone comparison.

modes.label: Add-on wording
modes.description: The word adding, addition, added or administration when one drug is put on top of another.
modes.example: The incremental LDL-C reduction due to<< adding>> ezetimibe to cholesty

modes.label: Linking word before drug alone
modes.description: A word like by or with just before a named drug followed by alone.
modes.example: than would be induced<< by>> estrogen treatment alone.

card.plain: It marks the spot where a text talks about adding a second drug to a first one.
